description: Read a shipped tool schema by name and kind (input or output). Returns its JSON Schema, package-relative file, recorded file hash and source URL. tools/list describes this endpoint’s narrower accepted inputs; the full schema may describe operations outside the hosted tools.

kind.description: The tool's input schema or its output schema.

name.description: Any OODS Foundry tool at this version, local-only tools included.

reproduce.description: Include the command and calls for reproducing this result.

name: tool_schema
title: Read Tool Schema
